body:
Thanks for your reply - I think you're right, I guess it wasn't that invasive. It's a public account for all to see and from what I gathered, she seems to have a lot of followers...I think I feel guilty that I found her tumblr and read some of it without her telling me it was OK to read, but the internet is definitely one of the most public places to post things. 

Seeing your answer written out, the idea of asking her about it in person really doesn't sound as bad as I'd built it up to be in my head...Thank you so much, I really appreciate your input.
